## Change

Describe the smallest coherent change and the issue/proposition it addresses.

## Authority and scope

State which ONDTF surface is authoritative for the change and what remains delegated or external.

## Evidence

List validation commands, tests, generated evidence, and important negative/boundary cases.

## Compatibility

Describe normative, profile, schema, release, or adopter impact. State explicitly when there is no breaking change.

## Residual risk / deferred work

Record unresolved evidence gaps, limitations, or deliberately deferred work.

## Completion checklist

- [ ] Issue/proposition and acceptance criteria are linked.
- [ ] Relevant validation/build checks pass.
- [ ] Normative and informative content remain distinguishable.
- [ ] Documentation/navigation/examples are synchronized.
- [ ] Breaking change, if any, is explicitly declared with migration/reassessment impact.
- [ ] The judgment that should remain visible after merge is captured here, in tests, or in durable documentation.
